description: This file defines internal classes and templates for managing memory layout of arrays with dynamic sizes, including alignment, offset calculations, and pointer utilities, as part of the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::Layout
classes.description: Template class for defining memory layouts of multiple arrays with specified sizes and alignments.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::LayoutImpl
classes.description: Internal implementation class handling detailed memory layout calculations, offsets, and pointer arithmetic.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::Aligned
classes.description: Type wrapper to specify custom alignment for array elements.

methods.name: Layout::Partial
methods.description: Returns a partial layout with specified sizes for a subset of arrays.

methods.name: Layout::Pointer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the start of a specific array within the layout.

methods.name: Layout::Slices
methods.description: Returns tuples of span objects for all arrays with known sizes.

methods.name: Layout::AllocSize
methods.description: Calculates total memory size needed for the layout.

methods.name: Layout::DebugString
methods.description: Provides a human-readable string describing the memory layout.
